title: Fuzzy Wurm Crawler
move_pattern: Alternates: Acid Goop → Inhale → Acid Goop (repeats). Inhale applies Strength and causes the monster to puff up.
notes: The monster has two visual states: normal and puffed. It becomes puffed after Inhale and returns to normal after Acid Goop. These are cosmetic animation changes and do not affect the move pattern or damage values.
